code.description: JavaScript cell body (top-level await allowed) run in this conversation's persistent session; `return` a value to see it.

args.description: Optional input data exposed as the args global for this cell.

reset.description: Stop every worker and discard the session's variables before running code (code may be omitted).

run_in_background.description: Set to true only when the cell should return a task ID immediately. Ordinary cells already yield automatically if they are still running after a brief wait, and completion is delivered without polling.
